scope: Confirmed natural-turn ingress/cancellation isolation, compatible wire9; no deployment or device/model acceptance

regressions.invariant: old and new messages remain durably accepted, no Worker cancellation

test_fixture_audit: Direct Receiver callback tests must wait for the actual foreground heartbeat. Initial fixture omitted this in one case; fixed before the final old-main comparison. No product timeout/threshold changed.
failure_cleanup: Cancelled terminal wait removes its AbortSignal listener; dispatched Admin request retains its original 15-second RPC lifetime and durable ownership.
Only the exact input-preparation object may apply a fetched config or send turn_ready; cancelled/stale errors do not mutate successors.
Binary data is wiped after validation; bad ID/sequence/size and audio before turn_ready still reject. No new audio queue.
Queries are read-only, keep original RPC timeouts, and never create/retry business work. Current-query errors still reject the current interaction.
unchanged: installed backend/APK/ADB and real business data
